description:
Discussion channel:
https://discord.com/channels/438379928883298305/1455673986905280635
_Additional event details-like what to bring/pack are in the pinned post_

Hi y’all, we look forward to families joining our family in the woods for Wildschooling Gatherings. I've currently set them for reoccurring Wednesdays at 10:00am. Call/text 919-455-0564 if you need anything.

title: Wildschooling Gathering (Fxbg)
description:
Discussion Channel: https://discord.com/channels/438379928883298305/1532544640987693156.
We will plan to meet at Mott's Run through October:Drive down the hill to the parking lot with the reservoir/kayaks/dock. There's a bathroom there as well. Away from the water is an opening in the fence with a short gravel walk to a natural play space and lots of picnic table seating along the reservoir/in the woods. Also, a porta potty. The .8 mile Turkey Trail loop is right there for a hike into the woods(steep uphill for a bit) with two outdoor "school" spaces and a nice hike!
We will gather and hike, stopping at the first outside classroom for Wildschooling Picnic Circle. This invitation will rotate weekly each month. A calendar will soon be in the pinned post section of the discussion channel. After Circle we will continue the hike looping back to where we started. From there we can opem the Circle activities back up, invite work ok the Seasonal Hamdcraft (Pine Needle Baskets), free play, etc

title: Engineering Club: Adaptive Toys
description:
Our Engineering group has been focused on adaptive toys for several months now. The group has gained some experience, but also learns about the best way to solder, or access the board of a new toy every week.

This is an open group that meets out of my home for anyone interested in the project.

title: Revolutions! Remote study of a revolution
description:
Listening to a Revolution!

The format of this activity will be to arrive in [the discord voice call](https://discord.com/channels/438379928883298305/1109187178661150852) to listen to a portion of the book "The Storm Before the Storm" by Mike Duncan

title: Art Hub
description:
Discussion channel: https://discord.com/channels/438379928883298305/1544669678046158928

Come make some art with us! This is for all ages!! Every Monday we meet we will be ready to guide you through a project as a group (with all supplies for the project provided). So just bring your artsy brain and let’s create together.

If you don’t want to do the project we have planned please feel free to bring anything you want to work on and just hang out. The goal of this club is to get those creative juices flowing while spending time with our FAHA friends. See you at the HUB!

At the end of the school year we are planning on doing an Art Exhibition Party to showcase all of the kids favorite works.

title: I Dig George Field Trip
description:
Applying critical thinking skills, primary sources, and historical research, Ferry Farm archaeologists regularly make new, exciting discoveries about George Washington. In I Dig George, students become archaeologists and conduct a simulated dig to learn more about the archaeological process. Students are challenged to think critically about the artifacts they uncover, and they learn how artifacts helped Ferry Farm archaeologists rebuild the Washington House.

This event is targeted for kids K-5. The cost is $6 per child and $4 per adult, payment can be made the day of on site. Please pack a lunch as we will be breaking for lunch between stations. I’m excited to dig with our FaHa friends!
